title: Curated evidence bundle: sparkline thumbnails + hypothesis scorecards for PD/Slack incidents
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: PagerDuty and Slack incident notices today include raw links to traces and dashboards; on-call engineers spend 5–20 minutes assembling a coherent timeline and checking metric deltas before triage. We want an automated evidence bundle that attaches a small, prioritized set of artifacts to PD incidents and Slack threads: condensed trace timeline (top 5 spans), metric sparkline thumbnails (3–6s PNGs), and an ML-backed hypothesis scorecard (ranked causal hypotheses with confidence scores). The bundle must redact secrets, respect PII policies, and fit within PD/Slack attachment size limits.

Goals:
- Reduce median time-to-first-action on P1s by 40% by surfacing curated evidence.
- Standardize the initial postmortem seed and attach it to the incident (with an editable link).
- Provide interactive Slack buttons for 'Acknowledge + Tag', 'Request Rollback', and 'Create Postmortem Draft'.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement a full causal inference model; we will use a lightweight classifier+heuristics for hypothesis scoring in phase 1.

Constraints:
- Attachments must not exceed 6MB per PD event and must comply with internal redaction rules.
- The feature must work for both hosted (Redwood API) and Dedicated/Private deployments; private installs may disable ML hypothesis scoring via a config flag.
acceptance_criteria: PD incidents created from alert rules automatically receive an evidence bundle containing: trace timeline (top 5 spans), metric sparkline thumbnails for affected metrics, and a hypothesis scorecard (3 highest-ranked hypotheses)
Slack incident thread created by PD -> Slack integration shows the same bundle and renders interactive buttons for rollback request and postmortem draft creation
Generated sparkline thumbnails are generated server-side, compressed, and below 200KB each; total attachment payload < 6MB
Evidence bundle honors redaction policy: spans and logs flagged for PII are omitted and replaced with redaction markers
Feature has an opt-out toggle for Dedicated/Private via config: observability.attach_evidence_bundle = false
Automated postmortem seed is produced and linked to the incident with sections: summary, timeline, artifacts, initial hypotheses, next steps
deliverables: Backend service (evidence-bundler) that accepts an incident context and produces a zipped attachment payload
Trace summarizer module (top-span extractor + condensed timeline formatter)
Sparkline generator in the metrics service with compression and thumbnail endpoints
Hypothesis scorecard service (classifier + heuristic rules) with explainability fields
PagerDuty payload adaptor to attach bundle and set custom fields
Slack adapter to post message blocks with attachments and interactive actions
Postmortem seed generator that writes a draft to the PM Confluence space or internal docs with link back to incident
